metadata.short_desc: A starter template demonstrating AstrBot plugin capabilities.
metadata.desc: An AstrBot plugin template demonstrating commands, message events, plugin config, i18n, plugin Pages, AI tools, storage, HTML-to-image rendering and session control. Suitable as a starting template for maintaining an AstrBot plugin repository.

greeting.hint: Used as the greeting in the /helloworld command reply.

count_limit.hint: The /count counter resets to zero when reaching this limit.

enable_ai.hint: When disabled, AI commands like /ask will be unavailable.

enable_decorate.description: Append an exclamation mark to replies
enable_decorate.hint: Only for demonstrating the on_decorating_result hook; when enabled, all replies get an exclamation mark.

enable_waiting_hint.description: Send a "thinking..." hint before LLM response
enable_waiting_hint.hint: Only for demonstrating the on_waiting_llm_request hook; when enabled, a hint message is sent before every LLM call. Disabled by default to avoid affecting daily chat.

tags.hint: Custom tags, each element is a string.

ai_provider.hint: Select a configured chat model provider from the dropdown in the WebUI.

tts_provider.hint: Select a configured text-to-speech provider from the dropdown in the WebUI.

stt_provider.hint: Select a configured speech-to-text provider from the dropdown in the WebUI.

persona.hint: Select a configured persona from the dropdown in the WebUI.

knowledgebase.hint: Multi-select configured knowledge bases in the WebUI.

demo.title: Demo Page
demo.description: Demonstrates how a plugin Page talks to the plugin backend API.
demo.heading: Plugin Pages Demo
demo.desc: A minimal plugin Page talking to the plugin backend via the AstrBotPluginPage bridge.
